name: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc., a pharmaceutical company, engages in the development and commercialization of small-molecule, anti-inflammatory, and anti-fibrotic drugs targeting organ fibrosis. The company offers ETUARY (Pirfenidone), an anti-fibrotic drug approved for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; and under Phase 3 trials for the treatment of pneumoconiosis. It is also involved in the development of F351 (Hydronidone), a structural derivative of ETUARY under Phase 3 trials for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (CHB)-associated liver fibrosis; and completed Phase 1 trials for the treatment of liver fibrosis associated with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis.
